_comment: Copy this file to .b24.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your webhook. The b24_call MCP tool reads it to make live REST calls against your Bitrix24 portal. To create the webhook: Bitrix24 → Developer resources → Inbound webhook, grant the scopes you need (crm, tasks, user, im, main, ...) and copy the resulting URL's userId + token below.
